algorithm.name: 阶段迁移与Attention结构守卫统一构造
algorithm.method: Single-cut exact stages; ordinary fixed/rotating repeated stages; closed attention and FFN packing; otherwise preserved guarded tree policy. Structure-driven direct construction; one E0 for direct routes, at most two for guarded with certified pruning. No historical plan lookup.

offline_costs: No training or graph-specific scored lookup; archived research/census/formal cases are development evidence only. Dependency install/source verification and actual dispatch environment retained by producer. No E1/E2 or Colab in this manifest.

metadata.complexity: recognition worst-case O(C*(V+E)) for C final-DIV candidates; quotient/placement O(k*(V+E)+(V+E) log V); final ready pass O((V+E) log V+kV)
guards: positive M/V compute cycles
unique tensor producers and no direct op edges
raw tensor dependencies equal COPY-contracted compute dependencies
closed nonoverlapping attention/FFN capsules and acyclic quotient
one raw output and shared Q/K/V plus scalar frontier
four original M/V/V/M FFN ops outside rows; no raw nonterminal tensor consumer outside the diamond
metadata.submission: Original ops remain singleton subgraphs; per-core Tasks are rederived by official P3.
limitations: No COPY service, DDR contention, cache, capacity or spill model; not an official score or claimed official bound.
Only row/FFN placement is shared; each op uses its own original predecessor release, no all-frontier barrier.
Placement is chosen using contiguous capsule trial words; the final op-level ready pass may improve or worsen that proxy and does not revisit ownership.
Bottom-level and remote tensor bytes are proxies, not optimality guarantees or actual traffic.
A fixed row/FFN/chain placement family can miss useful splits; packing does not fuse, clone or remove original ops.
